using System;
using System.Linq;
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.SceneManagement;
using UnityEngine.UI;
using UnityEditor;
public static class QABatchDefenseCompileCheck { public static object Execute() {
// C#6 execute_code method body. GENERATED by build_batch.py; QA only.
// Requires Play mode. A ready Main matching the first pending case can be reused;
// otherwise start from Title. All case logs are protected from overwrite.
// Root performs and verifies PlayerPrefs/editor restoration after the final Play stop.
const string bFolder="QA/DefenseBugfix20261016/";
const string bPlanFile="batch-cases.csv";
foreach(string backup in new[]{"session-backup-ready.txt","playerprefs-before.txt","editor-before.txt","gameview-before.txt","logger-before.txt","logger-enabled-before.txt"})if(!System.IO.File.Exists(bFolder+backup))throw new System.Exception("Capture current session backup before running: "+backup);
if(System.IO.File.ReadAllLines(bFolder+"playerprefs-before.txt").Count(line=>!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line))!=8)throw new System.Exception("Expected exactly 8 PlayerPrefs backup rows");
if(!Application.isPlaying)throw new System.Exception("Start Play in Title, wait for native managers, then execute BatchDefense; no delegates are installed across the initial Play/domain reload");
foreach(string bGuardName in new[]{"batch-progress.txt","native-survival-progress.txt","benchmark-progress.txt"}){
 if(System.IO.File.Exists(bFolder+bGuardName)&&System.IO.File.ReadAllText(bFolder+bGuardName).StartsWith("RUNNING"))throw new System.Exception("Already running or unreviewed RUNNING marker: "+bGuardName);
}
if(System.IO.File.Exists(bFolder+"cancel-native-survival.txt")||System.IO.File.Exists(bFolder+"cancel-defense-batch.txt"))throw new System.Exception("Cancellation sentinel exists; review before starting");
System.Func<string,string> bHash=bPath=>{using(var bSha=System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256.Create()){return System.BitConverter.ToString(bSha.ComputeHash(System.IO.File.ReadAllBytes(bPath))).Replace("-","").ToLowerInvariant();}};
if(bHash(bFolder+"NativeSurvivalBootstrap.cs.txt")!="983097ba210d3cac3f2342e933690c6c915b1f4e64f226eb07e963e94aa3e649"||bHash(bFolder+"RegressionSurvivalRoute.cs.txt")!="dcb8685669a8bbd3b78ea0f32c866318bac7134bc672fc5327fe7aa20b512160"||bHash(bFolder+bPlanFile)!="00458218a6d108bca64d5ae891f80482f27835251f501fd4c86b0978b0e9cb56")throw new System.Exception("Batch source/plan changed; rerun build_batch.py before execution");
var bPlanLines=System.IO.File.ReadAllLines(bFolder+bPlanFile).Where(bLine=>!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(bLine)&&!bLine.TrimStart().StartsWith("#")).ToArray();
if(bPlanLines.Length<2||bPlanLines[0].Trim()!="label,weapon,start_stage,profile,seed,STR,ACC,moduleDamage,repair,barrier,punk,scrap_module,initial_hp,initial_gate")throw new System.Exception("Invalid batch case header");
var bHeader=bPlanLines[0].Split(',');
var bCases=new System.Collections.Generic.List<System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<string,string>>();
var bAllLabels=new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<string>();
foreach(string bLine in bPlanLines.Skip(1)){
 var bCells=bLine.Split(',');if(bCells.Length!=bHeader.Length)throw new System.Exception("Invalid batch CSV row");
 var bEntry=new System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<string,string>();for(int bColumn=0;bColumn<bHeader.Length;bColumn++)bEntry[bHeader[bColumn]]=bCells[bColumn].Trim();
 string bLabel=bEntry["label"];if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(bLabel)||bLabel.IndexOfAny(System.IO.Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars())>=0||bLabel.Contains("/")||bLabel.Contains("\\")||!bAllLabels.Add(bLabel))throw new System.Exception("Invalid or duplicate label: "+bLabel);
 foreach(string bNumeric in new[]{"start_stage","seed","STR","ACC","moduleDamage","initial_hp"})int.Parse(bEntry[bNumeric],System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
 float.Parse(bEntry["initial_gate"],System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
 foreach(string bFlag in new[]{"repair","barrier","punk","scrap_module"})if(bEntry[bFlag]!="0"&&bEntry[bFlag]!="1")throw new System.Exception("Invalid flag "+bFlag);
 bCases.Add(bEntry);
}
System.Func<string,System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<string,string>> bReadResult=bPath=>{
 var bMap=new System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<string,string>();
 if(System.IO.File.Exists(bPath))foreach(string bLine in System.IO.File.ReadAllLines(bPath)){int bEquals=bLine.IndexOf('=');if(bEquals>0)bMap[bLine.Substring(0,bEquals)]=bLine.Substring(bEquals+1);}
 return bMap;
};
var bSkipped=new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();
var bPending=new System.Collections.Generic.List<System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<string,string>>();
foreach(var bEntry in bCases){
 string bLabel=bEntry["label"],bResultPath=bFolder+bLabel+"-result.txt";
 if(System.IO.File.Exists(bResultPath)){
  var bPrior=bReadResult(bResultPath);if(!bPrior.ContainsKey("result")||!bPrior.ContainsKey("game_seconds")||!bPrior.ContainsKey("last_stage"))throw new System.Exception("Incomplete existing result; no overwrite: "+bLabel);
  bSkipped.Add(bLabel);continue;
 }
 if(System.IO.Directory.GetFiles(bFolder,bLabel+"-*").Length>0)throw new System.Exception("Partial case artifacts already exist; use a new label or review recovery: "+bLabel);
 bPending.Add(bEntry);
}
if(bPending.Count==0)return "No pending cases: all "+bCases.Count+" result files already exist; no files overwritten";
string bFirstScene=UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene().name;
bool bReuseInitialMain=false;
if(bFirstScene=="Main"){
 var bFirst=bPending[0];string bExpected=bFirst["weapon"]+","+bFirst["start_stage"]+","+bFirst["profile"]+","+bFirst["seed"];
 string bReady=System.IO.File.Exists(bFolder+"native-survival-bootstrap-progress.txt")?System.IO.File.ReadAllText(bFolder+"native-survival-bootstrap-progress.txt"):"";
 string bUsed=System.IO.File.Exists(bFolder+"native-survival-bootstrap-config-used.txt")?System.IO.File.ReadAllLines(bFolder+"native-survival-bootstrap-config-used.txt").FirstOrDefault():"";
 if(!bReady.StartsWith("READY "+bExpected+" ")||bUsed!=bExpected||Time.timeScale!=0f)throw new System.Exception("Main startup cannot be safely discarded: first pending case must match existing paused READY bootstrap, otherwise start from Title");
 bReuseInitialMain=true;
}else if(bFirstScene!="Title"&&bFirstScene!="Ending"&&bFirstScene!="CraftSpace")throw new System.Exception("Unsupported batch start scene: "+bFirstScene);
string bSession=System.DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMdd-HHmmss-fff"),bEventsPath=bFolder+"batch-events-"+bSession+".csv";
if(System.IO.File.Exists(bEventsPath))throw new System.Exception("Batch session filename collision");
System.IO.File.WriteAllText(bEventsPath,"wall_seconds,event,case_label,details\n");
System.IO.File.WriteAllText(bFolder+"batch-cases-used-"+bSession+".csv",System.IO.File.ReadAllText(bFolder+bPlanFile));
float bOldScale=Time.timeScale,bOldCapture=Time.captureDeltaTime;int bOldVsync=QualitySettings.vSyncCount,bOldTarget=Application.targetFrameRate;bool bOldBackground=Application.runInBackground,bOldLogEnabled=Debug.unityLogger.logEnabled;LogType bOldFilter=Debug.unityLogger.filterLogType;
System.IO.File.WriteAllText(bFolder+"batch-runtime-before-"+bSession+".txt","timeScale="+bOldScale+"\ncaptureDeltaTime="+bOldCapture+"\nvSync="+bOldVsync+"\ntargetFrameRate="+bOldTarget+"\nrunInBackground="+bOldBackground+"\nloggerEnabled="+bOldLogEnabled+"\nloggerFilter="+(int)bOldFilter+"\n");
Debug.unityLogger.filterLogType=LogType.Error;
System.Action bBootstrapCleanup=null;
System.Action<string> bRouteFinish=null;
System.Func<string> bRunBootstrap=()=>{
// C#6 execute_code method body. Title Play only; changes runtime state and existing backed-up prefs only.
// Input: native-survival-config.csv contains one row: weapon,startStage,profile(loadouts.csv ID),seed.
// Example: RailCraft,19,late,77
// Wait for native-survival-bootstrap-progress.txt to say READY, then execute NativeSurvivalRoute.cs.txt.
const string folder="QA/DefenseBugfix20261016/";
if(!Application.isPlaying||UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene().name!="Title")throw new System.Exception("Bootstrap requires Title in Play mode");
foreach(string name in new[]{"benchmark-progress.txt","native-survival-progress.txt"})if(System.IO.File.Exists(folder+name)&&System.IO.File.ReadAllText(folder+name).StartsWith("RUNNING"))throw new System.Exception("Another benchmark is still running: "+name);
if(MainDebugEnemySpawnWindow.IsDebugModeActive)throw new System.Exception("Disable enemy debug mode before the survival test");
var lines=System.IO.File.ReadAllLines(folder+"native-survival-config.csv").Where(line=>!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line)&&!line.TrimStart().StartsWith("#")&&!line.TrimStart().StartsWith("weapon,")).ToArray();
if(lines.Length!=1)throw new System.Exception("Expected exactly one config row: weapon,startStage,profile,seed");
var fields=lines[0].Split(',').Select(value=>value.Trim()).ToArray();if(fields.Length!=4)throw new System.Exception("Expected four config columns");
string weaponName=fields[0],profile=fields[2];int stage=int.Parse(fields[1]),seed=int.Parse(fields[3]);
if(!new[]{"GearCraft","SteamCannon","SteamThrower","RailCraft","SteamGatling"}.Contains(weaponName))throw new System.Exception("Unknown workshop weapon: "+weaponName);
var loadoutLines=System.IO.File.ReadAllLines(folder+"loadouts.csv").Where(line=>!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line)&&!line.TrimStart().StartsWith("#")&&!line.TrimStart().StartsWith("profile,")).Select(line=>line.Split(',')).Where(row=>row.Length==3&&row[0].Trim()==profile).ToArray();
if(loadoutLines.Length!=1)throw new System.Exception("Expected exactly one matching loadout: "+profile);
int moduleDamage=int.Parse(loadoutLines[0][2],System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
var partNames=loadoutLines[0][1].Split(';').Where(name=>!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name)).Select(name=>name.Trim()).OrderBy(name=>name).ToArray();
var placementLines=System.IO.File.ReadAllLines(folder+"loadout-placements.csv").Where(line=>!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line)&&!line.TrimStart().StartsWith("#")&&!line.TrimStart().StartsWith("profile,")).Select(line=>line.Split(',')).Where(row=>row.Length==5&&row[0].Trim()==profile).ToArray();
if(!partNames.SequenceEqual(placementLines.Select(row=>row[1].Trim()).OrderBy(name=>name).ToArray()))throw new System.Exception("Placement assets/counts do not exactly match loadout "+profile);
var placements=new System.Collections.Generic.List<StatusManager.SavedUpgradePartPlacement>();
foreach(var placementRow in placementLines){
 string assetName=placementRow[1].Trim();var part=UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<UpgradePartSO>("Assets/GearCraft/ScriptableObject/UpgradeParts/"+assetName+".asset");
 if(part==null)throw new System.Exception("Upgrade part asset missing: "+assetName);
 var placement=new StatusManager.SavedUpgradePartPlacement();placement.partData=part;placement.gridX=int.Parse(placementRow[2]);placement.gridY=int.Parse(placementRow[3]);placement.rotation=int.Parse(placementRow[4]);placement.inventoryIndex=placements.Count;placements.Add(placement);
}
var stageConfig=UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<StageGeneratorSO>("Assets/GearCraft/ScriptableObject/StageGeneratorConfig/StageGeneratorConfig.asset");
if(stageConfig==null||stage<1||stage>stageConfig.totalStages)throw new System.Exception("Stage is outside configured campaign");
string weaponAsset=weaponName=="GearCraft"?"GearCraft_Sword":weaponName;
var target=UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<WeaponDataSO>("Assets/GearCraft/ScriptableObject/WeaponData/"+weaponAsset+".asset");
var axe=UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<WeaponDataSO>("Assets/GearCraft/ScriptableObject/WeaponData/GearCraft_Axe.asset");
var status=StatusManager.Instance;var materials=MaterialManager.Instance;
if(status==null||materials==null||target==null||(weaponName=="GearCraft"&&axe==null))throw new System.Exception("Title managers or target weapon assets missing");
string[] backup=System.IO.File.ReadAllLines(folder+"playerprefs-before.txt");
var backupKeys=new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<string>();
foreach(string line in backup){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line))continue;var c=line.Split('|');if(c.Length!=3)throw new System.Exception("Invalid backup row");bool.Parse(c[1]);backupKeys.Add(c[0]);if(c[1]=="True"){if(c[0].Contains(".Metrics.")||c[0].Contains("Gallery.Progress"))System.Convert.FromBase64String(c[2]);else int.Parse(c[2]);}}
if(!backupKeys.Contains("GearCraft.Gallery.Progress.v1")||!backupKeys.Contains("GearCraft.Main.OpeningNotice.Seen.v1"))throw new System.Exception("Backup does not cover the prefs touched by bootstrap");
float beforeScale=Time.timeScale,beforeCapture=Time.captureDeltaTime;int beforeVsync=QualitySettings.vSyncCount,beforeTarget=Application.targetFrameRate;bool beforeBackground=Application.runInBackground;
var invariant=System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
System.IO.File.WriteAllText(folder+"native-survival-bootstrap-time-before.txt",status.GetInstanceID()+"|"+beforeScale.ToString("R",invariant)+"|"+beforeCapture.ToString("R",invariant)+"|"+beforeVsync+"|"+beforeTarget+"|"+beforeBackground+"\n");
System.Action restoreOnFailure=()=>{
 // Root restores PlayerPrefs from this session backup after failure; avoid persistent cross-case callbacks.
 System.IO.File.WriteAllText(folder+"native-survival-bootstrap-restore-pending.txt","Bootstrap failed; root must restore PlayerPrefs/editor backup after Play stops.\n");
 Time.timeScale=beforeScale;Time.captureDeltaTime=beforeCapture;QualitySettings.vSyncCount=beforeVsync;Application.targetFrameRate=beforeTarget;Application.runInBackground=beforeBackground;
};
UnityEditor.EditorApplication.CallbackFunction readyCheck=null;double requestedAt=UnityEditor.EditorApplication.timeSinceStartup;
bBootstrapCleanup=()=>{if(readyCheck!=null)UnityEditor.EditorApplication.update-=readyCheck;};
try{
 // ResetRunProgress's DormTasks/CraftTutorialRunProgress resets are memory-only. InitializeWeapons may
 // update GalleryProgress.SaveKey, which is already in the existing backup; no new pref keys are used.
 status.ResetRunProgress();materials.ClearAllMaterials();
 status.AcquireWeapon(target);if(weaponName=="GearCraft")status.AcquireWeapon(axe);status.EquipWeapon(target);
 int day=(stage-1)/3+1;
 status.STR=status.ACC=2*(day-1);status.craftWeaponDamagebuff=moduleDamage;
 status.ownedUpgradeParts=placements.Select(placement=>placement.partData).ToList();status.savedUpgradePartPlacements=placements;
 status.RecalculateUpgradeEffects();
 status.HP=100;status.GATE=100f;status.SAN=100;
 status.bossKillCount=stageConfig.bossStages.Count(bossStage=>bossStage<stage);
 // ResetRunProgress disables modules/Punk/weapon-specific cards. Validated saved placements above preserve the same part effects after native EquipWeapon calls.
 var counter=StageCounter.Instance;if(counter==null)counter=new GameObject("QA_NativeSurvival_StageCounter").AddComponent<StageCounter>();counter.StageCount=stage;
 PlayerPrefs.SetInt("GearCraft.Main.OpeningNotice.Seen.v1",1);PlayerPrefs.Save();
 System.IO.File.WriteAllText(folder+"native-survival-bootstrap-config-used.txt",lines[0]+"\nday="+day+"\nboss_kills="+status.bossKillCount+"\nHP=100\nGATE=100\nflat_damage="+status.bonusDamage.ToString("R",invariant)+"\nattack_speed="+status.attackSpeedMult.ToString("R",invariant)+"\nmodule_damage="+status.craftWeaponDamagebuff+"\nparts="+string.Join(";",partNames)+"\nplacements="+string.Join(";",placementLines.Select(row=>string.Join(":",row)).ToArray())+"\ndouble_shot="+status.hasBulletDouble+"\nspread_modifier="+status.spreadModifier.ToString("R",invariant)+"\nricochet="+status.ricochetCount+"\nbullet_size="+status.bulletSizeMult.ToString("R",invariant)+"\ninitial_hit_damage="+status.GetWeaponDamage(target).ToString("R",invariant)+"\nasset="+UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(target)+"\n");
 System.IO.File.WriteAllText(folder+"native-survival-bootstrap-progress.txt","LOADING "+lines[0]+"\n");
 UnityEngine.Random.InitState(seed);Time.timeScale=0f;
 readyCheck=()=>{
  try{
   if(!Application.isPlaying)throw new System.Exception("Play stopped before bootstrap became ready");
   if(UnityEditor.EditorApplication.timeSinceStartup-requestedAt>30)throw new System.Exception("Native Main initialization exceeded 30 wall seconds");
   if(UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene().name!="Main")return;
   var player=UnityEngine.Object.FindFirstObjectByType<PlayerController>();var flow=StageFlowManager.Instance;
   if(player==null||player.runtimeStatus!=status||flow==null||flow.EnemyScalingStage!=stage||player.armRotation==null)return;
   var flags=System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance|System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic;
   if(typeof(StageFlowManager).GetField("dayStartSnapshot",flags).GetValue(flow)==null)return;
   UnityEditor.EditorApplication.update-=readyCheck;
   System.IO.File.WriteAllText(folder+"native-survival-bootstrap-progress.txt","READY "+lines[0]+" Main native Start complete; timeScale="+Time.timeScale+"; run NativeSurvivalRoute.cs.txt\n");
  }catch(System.Exception ex){UnityEditor.EditorApplication.update-=readyCheck;restoreOnFailure();System.IO.File.WriteAllText(folder+"native-survival-bootstrap-progress.txt","FAILED "+ex+"\n");UnityEditor.EditorApplication.isPlaying=false;}
 };
 UnityEditor.EditorApplication.update+=readyCheck;
 UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.LoadScene("Main",UnityEngine.SceneManagement.LoadSceneMode.Single);
}catch(System.Exception ex){if(readyCheck!=null)UnityEditor.EditorApplication.update-=readyCheck;restoreOnFailure();System.IO.File.WriteAllText(folder+"native-survival-bootstrap-progress.txt","FAILED "+ex+"\n");UnityEditor.EditorApplication.isPlaying=false;throw;}
return "Loading paused Main for native survival: "+lines[0]+"; inspect native-survival-bootstrap-progress.txt for READY";

};
System.Func<string> bRunRoute=()=>{
// C#6 execute_code method body. Gate-aware version: retain player reactions; also intercept gate-bound damageable projectiles.
// Run only after the caller prepares an owned target weapon/build and loads Main through the normal scene path.
// This does not reset/stop/replace StageFlowManager or EnemySpawner, heal HP/GATE, or delete enemies/drops.
// Reward cards and the day-end report are confirmed through their actual scene Buttons.
const string folder="QA/DefenseBugfix20261016/";
if(!Application.isPlaying||UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene().name!="Main")throw new System.Exception("Main Play required");
if(System.IO.File.Exists(folder+"benchmark-progress.txt")&&System.IO.File.ReadAllText(folder+"benchmark-progress.txt").StartsWith("RUNNING"))throw new System.Exception("CombatBenchmark is still running; do not run concurrently");
string progress=folder+"native-survival-progress.txt";
if(System.IO.File.Exists(progress)&&System.IO.File.ReadAllText(progress).StartsWith("RUNNING"))throw new System.Exception("Native survival runner already active");
var flags=System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance|System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic|System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Public;
var flow=StageFlowManager.Instance;var status=StatusManager.Instance;var player=UnityEngine.Object.FindFirstObjectByType<PlayerController>();
if(flow==null||status==null||player==null||player.runtimeStatus!=status||status.currentWeapon==null)throw new System.Exception("Wait for native Main/Player.Start initialization before launching");
if(MainDebugEnemySpawnWindow.IsDebugModeActive)throw new System.Exception("Debug invulnerability must be off");
var mainWeapon=status.currentWeapon;string weaponName=mainWeapon.weaponName.StartsWith("GearCraft")?"GearCraft":mainWeapon.weaponName;
if(!status.ownedWeapons.Contains(mainWeapon))throw new System.Exception("The caller must own the initial target weapon, not only assign currentWeapon");
var sword=status.FindOwnedWeaponByName("GearCraft_Sword");var axe=status.FindOwnedWeaponByName("GearCraft_Axe");
if(weaponName=="GearCraft"&&(sword==null||axe==null))throw new System.Exception("Both GearCraft forms must be owned");
var arm=player.armRotation;var body=player.GetComponent<Rigidbody2D>();var playerCollider=player.GetComponent<Collider2D>();
if(arm==null||body==null||playerCollider==null)throw new System.Exception("Player native combat components missing");
string[] prefRows=System.IO.File.ReadAllLines(folder+"playerprefs-before.txt");
foreach(string line in prefRows){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line))continue;var columns=line.Split('|');if(columns.Length!=3)throw new System.Exception("Invalid PlayerPrefs backup row");bool.Parse(columns[1]);if(columns[1]=="True"){if(columns[0].Contains(".Metrics.")||columns[0].Contains("Gallery.Progress"))System.Convert.FromBase64String(columns[2]);else int.Parse(columns[2]);}}
int firstStage=StageCounter.Instance!=null?StageCounter.Instance.StageCount:1;
string label=System.IO.File.Exists(folder+"native-survival-name.txt")?System.IO.File.ReadAllText(folder+"native-survival-name.txt").Trim():"native-survival-"+weaponName+"-w"+firstStage+"-"+System.DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMdd-HHmmss");
if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(label)||label.IndexOfAny(System.IO.Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars())>=0||label.Contains("/")||label.Contains("\\"))throw new System.Exception("Invalid survival label");
string eventsPath=folder+label+"-events.csv";
var invariant=System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
System.Func<string,string> csv=value=>"\""+(value??"").Replace("\"","\"\"").Replace("\r","").Replace("\n"," | ")+"\"";
float started=Time.time,nextJump=Time.time,lastSample=-1f,lastHP=status.HP,lastGate=status.GATE;
float initialHP=status.HP,initialGate=status.GATE,playerDamage=0f,gateDamage=0f,playerHealed=0f,gateHealed=0f;
double wallStarted=UnityEditor.EditorApplication.timeSinceStartup,lastFrameAt=wallStarted;
int lastFrame=-1,shots=0,attackEvents=0,rewards=0,completedWaves=0,lastStage=firstStage,frames=0,spawned=0,killed=0,escaped=0;
bool done=false,wasActive=flow.IsStageActive,reportConfirmed=false,openingConfirmed=false;
bool oldPlayerEnabled=player.enabled,oldArmEnabled=arm.enabled;
float oldCapture=Time.captureDeltaTime,oldScale=Time.timeScale;int oldVSync=QualitySettings.vSyncCount,oldTarget=Application.targetFrameRate;bool oldBackground=Application.runInBackground;
// Bootstrap pauses before Main.Start. Restore the pre-bootstrap settings, not that temporary pause.
string timeHandoffPath=folder+"native-survival-bootstrap-time-before.txt";
if(System.IO.File.Exists(timeHandoffPath)){
 var handoff=System.IO.File.ReadAllText(timeHandoffPath).Trim().Split('|');
 if(handoff.Length!=6)throw new System.Exception("Invalid bootstrap time handoff");
 if(int.Parse(handoff[0])==status.GetInstanceID()){
  oldScale=float.Parse(handoff[1],invariant);oldCapture=float.Parse(handoff[2],invariant);oldVSync=int.Parse(handoff[3]);oldTarget=int.Parse(handoff[4]);oldBackground=bool.Parse(handoff[5]);
 }
}
var coolTimeField=typeof(PlayerController).GetField("coolTime",flags);
var coolTimeUpdate=typeof(PlayerController).GetMethod("CoolTimeUpdate",flags);
if(coolTimeField==null||coolTimeUpdate==null)throw new System.Exception("Native cooldown members missing");
float oldCoolTime=(float)coolTimeField.GetValue(player);
var staticFlags=System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Static|System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic|System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Public;
var calculateSpread=typeof(PlayerController).GetMethod("CalculateSpreadAngle",staticFlags);
var getBulletSpeed=typeof(PlayerController).GetMethod("GetCurrentBulletSpeed",flags);
var getMuzzle=typeof(PlayerController).GetMethod("GetMuzzlePosition",flags);
var lineAttack=typeof(PlayerController).GetMethod("PerformLineHitboxAttack",flags);
var gatlingRecoil=typeof(PlayerController).GetMethod("ApplySteamGatlingDownwardRecoil",flags);
if(calculateSpread==null||getBulletSpeed==null||getMuzzle==null||lineAttack==null||gatlingRecoil==null)throw new System.Exception("Native shot methods missing");
var configure=typeof(PlayerController).GetMethod("ConfigureSpawnedProjectile",flags);var sync=typeof(PlayerController).GetMethod("SyncWeaponFromStatus",flags);
var meleeAttack=typeof(PlayerController).GetMethod("PerformMeleeAttack",flags);var updateAnim=typeof(PlayerController).GetMethod("UpdateArmAnimation",flags);
var barrierUpdate=typeof(PlayerController).GetMethod("UpdateAutoBarrier",flags);
var damageField=typeof(PlayerController).GetField("currentDamage",flags);var poseMethod=typeof(ArmRotation).GetMethod("GetPoseIndex",flags);var offsetMethod=typeof(ArmRotation).GetMethod("GetOffset",flags);var scaleMethod=typeof(ArmRotation).GetMethod("GetScale",flags);
var tooltipDataField=typeof(BonusCardTooltipTrigger).GetField("cardData",flags);
var tracked=new System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<int,EnemyController>();var names=new System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<int,string>();var countedGone=new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<int>();
// Observations do not alter spawn plans, enemy state, damage, movement or bot decisions.
string bossPath=folder+label+"-bosses.csv",wavePath=folder+label+"-waves.csv",samplePath=folder+label+"-samples.csv";
var bossStarts=new System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<int,float[]>();
var bossLastHP=new System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<int,float>();
var closedBosses=new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<int>();
var enemyAIField=typeof(EnemyController).GetField("currentAI",flags);
int activeWave=0;float[] waveStart=null;float lastDiagnostic=-1f;
string attackSuppression="not_started";EnemyController diagnosticTarget=null;
System.Func<float,string> number=value=>value.ToString("R",invariant);
System.IO.File.WriteAllText(bossPath,"boss,stage,scaling_stage,event,result,spawn_game_seconds,event_game_seconds,boss_seconds,start_hp,start_gate,end_hp,end_gate,player_damage,gate_damage,player_healed,gate_healed,start_boss_hp,remaining_boss_hp,attack_events,player_x,player_y,boss_x,boss_y\n");
System.IO.File.WriteAllText(wavePath,"stage,scaling_stage,result,start_game_seconds,end_game_seconds,wave_seconds,start_hp,start_gate,end_hp,end_gate,player_damage,gate_damage,player_healed,gate_healed,attack_events\n");
System.IO.File.WriteAllText(samplePath,"game_seconds,stage,hp,gate,player_x,player_y,velocity_x,velocity_y,flow_active,input_blocked,cooldown,attack_suppression,attack_events,selected_target_id,enemy_id,enemy_name,enemy_hp,enemy_x,enemy_y,bounds_min_x,bounds_min_y,bounds_max_x,bounds_max_y,closest_distance,ai_type,ai_state,ai_phase,is_boss,live_enemy_count,forced_sample\n");
UnityEngine.Random.State aimRandom=UnityEngine.Random.state;
System.IO.File.WriteAllText(eventsPath,"game_seconds,wall_seconds,event,scene,stage,hp,gate,str,acc,flat_damage,module_damage,weapon,shots,spawned,killed,escaped,player_damage,gate_damage,attack_events,attack_speed,double_shot,spread_modifier,ricochet,bullet_size,details\n");
System.IO.File.WriteAllText(folder+label+"-initial-status.json",JsonUtility.ToJson(status,true));
if(System.IO.File.Exists(folder+"native-survival-bootstrap-config-used.txt"))System.IO.File.Copy(folder+"native-survival-bootstrap-config-used.txt",folder+label+"-bootstrap-config.txt",true);
if(MaterialManager.Instance!=null)System.IO.File.WriteAllText(folder+label+"-initial-materials.json",JsonUtility.ToJson(MaterialManager.Instance,true));
System.IO.File.WriteAllText(folder+label+"-meta.txt","One native day from caller-provided start/build. Native StageFlowManager/EnemySpawner remain enabled and unchanged. Native HP/GATE persist; no invulnerability, healing injection, enemy cleanup, artificial spawn replay, or wave resets. Native reward Buttons are selected by fixed policy: HP healing while HP <= 60; gate repair while GATE <= min(100, half initial GATE); then matching attack stat/conversion and target-weapon combat effects; otherwise first offered button. Crafted/upgraded initial build is not augmented through later craft/shop actions. Native rewards may add stats/effects/materials. The target weapon is re-equipped through EquipWeapon after weapon-grant rewards. Initial parts come from loadouts.csv plus validated saved placements; RecalculateUpgradeEffects applies native effects and retains them across re-equips. Actual native spread/muzzle/speed/line/projectile configuration/recoil methods are called, including native double-shot branch. Cooldown uses the native private timer and one CoolTimeUpdate call after each game frame including blocked/no-target frames. shots counts projectiles, attack_events counts attacks. Bot aim/movement and attacks derive from UpgradeCombatBenchmark.cs.txt including atan2-asin(muzzleOffset.y/distance) correction; native projectile/AI/physics are used. Gate-aware reactive policy retains player interception first and adds visible damageable projectiles predicted to meet Gate bounds within 1.2 seconds when no player interception target was chosen. Dash remains limited to player threats. Current-velocity prediction does not guarantee time to counter a projectile spawned overlapping the gate. Reactive policy reads visible projectile position/velocity every 0.2 seconds: shoot interceptable projectiles with native attacks; dodge other threatening bullets/bombs using native StartDash with normal duration/speed and wall limits. BOOST requires allow-boost.txt=true, consumes existing Gear, and is limited to two uses with a 5.5 second gap. No extra Gear, invulnerability or direct projectile damage/removal. Native auto-barrier maintenance is invoked because PlayerController.Update input handling is disabled. Stop after native day-end Continue reaches CraftSpace, HP/GATE depletion, Ending scene, 900 game seconds or 300 wall seconds. This is boss-day survival evidence, not an acquisition-to-ED playthrough or human playability proof. Additional boss/wave CSVs record start/end HP/GATE and observed net damage/healing; per-second samples include input suppression, target, positions and native enemy state. Damage/healing totals are frame-to-frame net changes, so same-frame healing and damage cannot be separated. Enemy despawns whose death was not observed are not counted as kills. Root restores PlayerPrefs after Play stops.\n");
System.Action<string,string> record=(eventName,details)=>{
 int stageNow=StageCounter.Instance!=null?StageCounter.Instance.StageCount:lastStage;
 string currentName=status!=null&&status.currentWeapon!=null?status.currentWeapon.weaponName:"";
 var values=new[]{(Time.time-started).ToString("F3",invariant),(UnityEditor.EditorApplication.timeSinceStartup-wallStarted).ToString("F3",invariant),eventName,UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene().name,stageNow.ToString(),status!=null?status.HP.ToString():"",status!=null?status.GATE.ToString("F2",invariant):"",status!=null?status.STR.ToString():"",status!=null?status.ACC.ToString():"",status!=null?status.bonusDamage.ToString("F3",invariant):"",status!=null?status.craftWeaponDamagebuff.ToString():"",currentName,shots.ToString(),spawned.ToString(),killed.ToString(),escaped.ToString(),playerDamage.ToString("F2",invariant),gateDamage.ToString("F2",invariant),attackEvents.ToString(),status!=null?status.attackSpeedMult.ToString("R",invariant):"",status!=null?status.hasBulletDouble.ToString():"",status!=null?status.spreadModifier.ToString("R",invariant):"",status!=null?status.ricochetCount.ToString():"",status!=null?status.bulletSizeMult.ToString("R",invariant):"",details};
 System.IO.File.AppendAllText(eventsPath,string.Join(",",values.Select(csv).ToArray())+"\n");
};
bool reactiveEnabled = System.IO.File.Exists(folder+"bot-mode.txt") && System.IO.File.ReadAllText(folder+"bot-mode.txt").Trim()=="reactive";
bool reactiveBoostAllowed = System.IO.File.Exists(folder+"allow-boost.txt") && System.IO.File.ReadAllText(folder+"allow-boost.txt").Trim()=="true";
int reactiveBoostBudget = 2, reactiveBoostUsed = 0;
float reactiveNextDecision = Time.time + 0.2f, reactiveNextDash = Time.time, reactiveNextBoost = Time.time;
Collider2D reactiveAimCollider = null;
int reactivePreviousTarget = 0;
var reactiveStartDash = typeof(PlayerController).GetMethod("StartDash",flags);
var reactiveDashTimer = typeof(PlayerController).GetField("dashTimer",flags);
var reactiveDashDirection = typeof(PlayerController).GetField("dashDirection",flags);
var reactiveBlockedWall = typeof(PlayerController).GetMethod("IsBlockedByWall",flags);
var reactiveBoost = typeof(PlayerController).GetMethod("BoostActive",flags);
var reactiveBoostActive = typeof(PlayerController).GetField("isBoostActive",flags);
var reactiveStopMovement = typeof(PlayerController).GetMethod("StopPlayerMovementInput",flags);
if(reactiveEnabled && (reactiveStartDash==null||reactiveDashTimer==null||reactiveDashDirection==null||reactiveBlockedWall==null||reactiveBoost==null||reactiveBoostActive==null||reactiveStopMovement==null))throw new System.Exception("Reactive bot native members missing");
record("bot_mode",reactiveEnabled?"reactive_gate_v1;decision=0.2s;gate_horizon=1.2s;player_interception_first;dash_player_threats_only;dash_gap=1.2s;BOOST_allowed="+reactiveBoostAllowed+";BOOST_budget=2;actual_inventory_only":"baseline;no intentional interception/dodge/BOOST");
System.Action<EnemyController> updateReactive = enemyTarget => {
 if(!reactiveEnabled)return;
 if(reactiveAimCollider!=null && (!reactiveAimCollider.enabled||!reactiveAimCollider.gameObject.activeInHierarchy))reactiveAimCollider=null;
 if(Time.time<reactiveNextDecision)return;
 reactiveNextDecision=Time.time+0.2f; // no catch-up loop: at most five decisions per game second
 var camera=Camera.main;
 var ownBounds=playerCollider.bounds;
 Vector2 ownCenter=ownBounds.center;
 Collider2D best=null;float bestTime=float.MaxValue;Vector2 bestVelocity=Vector2.zero;bool bestIsBomb=false;
 var threatColliders=new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<Collider2D>();
 foreach(var projectile in UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsByType<EnemyProjectileDamageable>(FindObjectsSortMode.None)){
  var candidate=projectile.GetComponent<Collider2D>();if(candidate!=null)threatColliders.Add(candidate);
 }
 foreach(var projectile in UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsByType<EnemyBulletController>(FindObjectsSortMode.None)){
  var candidate=projectile.GetComponent<Collider2D>();if(candidate!=null)threatColliders.Add(candidate);
 }
 foreach(var collider in threatColliders){
  var rb=collider.GetComponent<Rigidbody2D>();
  if(!collider.enabled||rb==null||!collider.gameObject.activeInHierarchy)continue;
  var enemyBullet=collider.GetComponent<EnemyBulletController>();bool bomb=enemyBullet!=null&&enemyBullet.bombBullet;
  Vector2 center=collider.bounds.center, relative=center-ownCenter, velocity=rb.linearVelocity-body.linearVelocity;
  if(relative.sqrMagnitude>64f||(!bomb&&velocity.sqrMagnitude<0.01f))continue;
  Vector3 viewport=camera!=null?camera.WorldToViewportPoint(collider.bounds.center):new Vector3(-1f,-1f,-1f);
  if(viewport.z<=0f||viewport.x<0f||viewport.x>1f||viewport.y<0f||viewport.y>1f)continue;
  float closestTime=velocity.sqrMagnitude>0.01f?-Vector2.Dot(relative,velocity)/velocity.sqrMagnitude:float.MaxValue;
  // A falling bomb threatens by its ground explosion, not only by direct body intersection.
  // Use the visible ground below it; do not assume airborne player feet are the ground plane.
  float explosionRadius=0f;
  if(bomb){
   float groundY=float.NaN;
   foreach(var hit in Physics2D.RaycastAll(collider.bounds.center,Vector2.down,20f)){
    if(hit.collider!=null&&!hit.collider.isTrigger&&hit.collider.CompareTag("Ground")){groundY=hit.point.y;break;}
   }
   if(!float.IsNaN(groundY)){
    float a=0.5f*Physics2D.gravity.y*rb.gravityScale,b=rb.linearVelocity.y,c=collider.bounds.min.y-groundY;
    float discriminant=b*b-4f*a*c;
    if(a<-0.001f&&discriminant>=0f)closestTime=(-b-Mathf.Sqrt(discriminant))/(2f*a);
    else if(b<-0.001f)closestTime=-c/b;
   }
   explosionRadius=Mathf.Max(0f,enemyBullet.bombRadius);
  }
  if(closestTime<0f||closestTime>1.2f)continue;
  Vector2 separation=relative+velocity*closestTime;
  if(bomb)separation.y+=0.5f*Physics2D.gravity.y*rb.gravityScale*closestTime*closestTime;
  Vector2 extents=(Vector2)ownBounds.extents+(Vector2)collider.bounds.extents+new Vector2(0.25f+explosionRadius,0.25f+explosionRadius);
  if(Mathf.Abs(separation.x)>extents.x||Mathf.Abs(separation.y)>extents.y)continue;
  if(closestTime<bestTime){bestTime=closestTime;best=collider;bestVelocity=rb.linearVelocity;bestIsBomb=bomb;}
 }
 // Normal weapons aim to the right. A projectile that passed behind the player can prompt
 // movement, but never forces an impossible backwards shot through the angle clamp.
 reactiveAimCollider=best!=null && best.GetComponent<EnemyProjectileDamageable>()!=null && best.bounds.center.x>player.FirePoint.position.x+0.15f ? best : null;
 // Keep player-directed interception first. Only an otherwise unused aim slot may defend the gate.
 // Gate prediction uses the current velocity against expanded 2D bounds, with the same 1.2s horizon.
 float reactiveAimTime=bestTime;string reactiveAimReason="player";
 var reactiveGate=GateManager.Instance;
 var reactiveGateCollider=reactiveGate!=null?reactiveGate.GetComponent<Collider2D>():null;
 if(reactiveAimCollider==null&&reactiveGateCollider!=null&&reactiveGateCollider.enabled&&reactiveGateCollider.gameObject.activeInHierarchy){
  Collider2D gateThreat=null;float gateThreatTime=float.MaxValue;
  Bounds gateBounds=reactiveGateCollider.bounds;
  foreach(var candidate in threatColliders){
   if(candidate==null||!candidate.enabled||!candidate.gameObject.activeInHierarchy||candidate.GetComponent<EnemyProjectileDamageable>()==null)continue;
   var projectileBody=candidate.GetComponent<Rigidbody2D>();if(projectileBody==null)continue;
   Vector2 center=candidate.bounds.center;
   if((center-ownCenter).sqrMagnitude>64f||center.x<=player.FirePoint.position.x+0.15f)continue;
   Vector3 viewport=camera!=null?camera.WorldToViewportPoint(candidate.bounds.center):new Vector3(-1f,-1f,-1f);
   if(viewport.z<=0f||viewport.x<0f||viewport.x>1f||viewport.y<0f||viewport.y>1f)continue;
   Vector2 relative=center-(Vector2)gateBounds.center;
   Vector2 velocity=projectileBody.linearVelocity;
   Vector2 extents=(Vector2)gateBounds.extents+(Vector2)candidate.bounds.extents+Vector2.one*0.25f;
   float enter=0f,exit=1.2f;bool intersects=true;
   for(int axis=0;axis<2;axis++){
    float position=axis==0?relative.x:relative.y,speed=axis==0?velocity.x:velocity.y,extent=axis==0?extents.x:extents.y;
    if(Mathf.Abs(speed)<0.001f){if(Mathf.Abs(position)>extent){intersects=false;break;}}
    else{
     float first=(-extent-position)/speed,last=(extent-position)/speed;
     enter=Mathf.Max(enter,Mathf.Min(first,last));exit=Mathf.Min(exit,Mathf.Max(first,last));
     if(enter>exit){intersects=false;break;}
    }
   }
   if(intersects&&enter<=1.2f&&exit>=0f&&enter<gateThreatTime){gateThreat=candidate;gateThreatTime=enter;}
  }
  if(gateThreat!=null){reactiveAimCollider=gateThreat;reactiveAimTime=gateThreatTime;reactiveAimReason="gate";}
 }
 int selected=reactiveAimCollider!=null?reactiveAimCollider.GetInstanceID():0;
 if(selected!=reactivePreviousTarget){record("reactive_intercept_target",reactiveAimCollider!=null?reactiveAimCollider.name+";threat="+reactiveAimReason+";predicted_contact="+reactiveAimTime.ToString("F3",System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture):"return_to_enemy");reactivePreviousTarget=selected;}
 if(best!=null && bestTime<(bestIsBomb?1f:0.45f) && Time.time>=reactiveNextDash && (float)reactiveDashTimer.GetValue(player)<=0f){
  // Select a legal horizontal escape endpoint; no teleport or invincibility is applied.
  int chosen=0;float bestClearance=float.MinValue;
  foreach(int direction in new[]{-1,1}){
   if((bool)reactiveBlockedWall.Invoke(player,new object[]{(float)direction}))continue;
   Vector2 endpoint=ownCenter+Vector2.right*(direction*player.dashSpeed*player.dashDuration);
   if(endpoint.x<-6.15f||endpoint.x>6.4f)continue;
   bool bodyBlocked=false;
   foreach(var hit in Physics2D.BoxCastAll(ownCenter,(Vector2)ownBounds.size*0.9f,0f,Vector2.right*direction,player.dashSpeed*player.dashDuration)){
    var c=hit.collider;if(c==null||c==playerCollider||c.isTrigger)continue;
    if(c.CompareTag("Wall")||c.GetComponent<EnemyController>()!=null){bodyBlocked=true;break;}
   }
   if(bodyBlocked)continue;
   Vector2 projectileEnd=(Vector2)best.bounds.center+bestVelocity*player.dashDuration;
   float clearance=(endpoint-projectileEnd).sqrMagnitude;
   if(clearance>bestClearance){bestClearance=clearance;chosen=direction;}
  }
  reactiveNextDash=Time.time+1.2f;
  if(chosen!=0){reactiveStartDash.Invoke(player,new object[]{chosen});record("reactive_dash",chosen+";native duration/speed;no invincibility");}
  else record("reactive_dash_blocked","no clear horizontal path");
 }
 // Do not spend during EK armor. A new 5-second BOOST must fit the explicitly limited budget.
 bool vulnerableBoss=enemyTarget!=null&&enemyTarget.enemyData!=null&&enemyTarget.enemyData.IsBossType;
 if(vulnerableBoss){var finalAI=enemyTarget.GetComponent<EnemyAI_BossFinal>();if(finalAI!=null&&finalAI.IsArmored)vulnerableBoss=false;}
 if(reactiveBoostAllowed&&reactiveBoostUsed<reactiveBoostBudget&&vulnerableBoss&&Time.time>=reactiveNextBoost&&!(bool)reactiveBoostActive.GetValue(player)&&MaterialManager.Instance!=null){
  int before=MaterialManager.Instance.GetMaterial(MaterialManager.MaterialType.Gear);
  if(before>0){
   reactiveBoost.Invoke(player,null); // native async method executes UseMaterial before its first await
   int after=MaterialManager.Instance.GetMaterial(MaterialManager.MaterialType.Gear);
   if(after==before-1){reactiveBoostUsed++;record("reactive_boost","gear "+before+" -> "+after+";use="+reactiveBoostUsed+"/"+reactiveBoostBudget);}
   else record("reactive_boost_not_started","stock unchanged");
  }
  reactiveNextBoost=Time.time+5.5f;
 }
};
// Call exactly ONCE per eligible game frame, even if there is no enemy target.
// StartDash alone only sets fields: normal HandleMovement consumes them, but runner disables Update.
System.Func<float,float> applyReactiveDash = ordinaryVx => {
 if(!reactiveEnabled)return ordinaryVx;
 float timer=(float)reactiveDashTimer.GetValue(player);
 if(timer<=0f)return ordinaryVx;
 int direction=(int)reactiveDashDirection.GetValue(player);
 reactiveDashTimer.SetValue(player,timer-Time.deltaTime);
 if((bool)reactiveBlockedWall.Invoke(player,new object[]{(float)direction})){reactiveDashTimer.SetValue(player,0f);return ordinaryVx;}
 return direction*player.dashSpeed;
};
System.Action<int,string,string> recordBoss=(id,eventName,result)=>{
 var start=bossStarts[id];EnemyController enemy=tracked.ContainsKey(id)?tracked[id]:null;
 if(enemy!=null)bossLastHP[id]=enemy.HP;
 var values=new[]{names[id],((int)start[8]).ToString(),((int)start[10]).ToString(),eventName,result,number(start[0]),number(Time.time-started),number(Time.time-started-start[0]),number(start[1]),number(start[2]),status!=null?number(status.HP):"",status!=null?number(status.GATE):"",number(playerDamage-start[3]),number(gateDamage-start[4]),number(playerHealed-start[5]),number(gateHealed-start[6]),number(start[7]),number(bossLastHP[id]),number(attackEvents-start[9]),player!=null?number(player.transform.position.x):"",player!=null?number(player.transform.position.y):"",enemy!=null?number(enemy.transform.position.x):"",enemy!=null?number(enemy.transform.position.y):""};
 System.IO.File.AppendAllText(bossPath,string.Join(",",values.Select(csv).ToArray())+"\n");
};
System.Action<string> closeWave=result=>{
 if(activeWave==0||waveStart==null)return;
 var v=waveStart;var values=new[]{activeWave.ToString(),((int)v[8]).ToString(),result,number(v[0]),number(Time.time-started),number(Time.time-started-v[0]),number(v[1]),number(v[2]),status!=null?number(status.HP):"",status!=null?number(status.GATE):"",number(playerDamage-v[3]),number(gateDamage-v[4]),number(playerHealed-v[5]),number(gateHealed-v[6]),number(attackEvents-v[7])};
 System.IO.File.AppendAllText(wavePath,string.Join(",",values.Select(csv).ToArray())+"\n");activeWave=0;waveStart=null;
};
System.Action<EnemyController[]> observeEnemies=all=>{
 foreach(var e in all){int id=e.GetInstanceID();if(!tracked.ContainsKey(id)&&e.HP>0f){
  tracked[id]=e;names[id]=e.enemyData!=null?e.enemyData.enemyName:e.name;spawned++;record("enemy_spawned",names[id]+" hp="+e.HP+" last="+e.isLastEnemy);
  if(e.enemyData!=null&&e.enemyData.IsBossType){bossStarts[id]=new[]{Time.time-started,(float)status.HP,status.GATE,playerDamage,gateDamage,playerHealed,gateHealed,e.HP,(float)(StageCounter.Instance!=null?StageCounter.Instance.StageCount:lastStage),(float)attackEvents,(float)(flow!=null?flow.EnemyScalingStage:lastStage)};bossLastHP[id]=e.HP;recordBoss(id,"spawned","active");}
 }}
 foreach(var pair in tracked){
  if(countedGone.Contains(pair.Key))continue;var e=pair.Value;
  if(e!=null&&bossStarts.ContainsKey(pair.Key))bossLastHP[pair.Key]=e.HP;
  // A Unity object destroyed before its zero HP was observed is recorded as unobserved, never assumed killed.
  bool dead=e!=null&&e.HP<=0f;var renderer=e!=null?e.GetComponentInChildren<SpriteRenderer>():null;
  bool vanished=e==null||!e.gameObject.activeInHierarchy||(renderer!=null&&!renderer.enabled);
  // Player death clears live enemies before retry; retain the boss for the terminal failure record.
  if(!dead&&vanished&&status!=null&&(status.HP<=0||status.GATE<=0))continue;
  if(!dead&&!vanished)continue;
  countedGone.Add(pair.Key);string outcome=dead?"defeated":e==null?"despawned_unobserved":"escaped_or_suicided";
  if(dead){killed++;record("enemy_killed",names[pair.Key]);}else{escaped++;record("enemy_escaped_or_suicided",names[pair.Key]+" outcome="+outcome);}
  if(bossStarts.ContainsKey(pair.Key)&&closedBosses.Add(pair.Key))recordBoss(pair.Key,"ended",outcome);
 }
};
System.Action<bool> sampleDiagnostics=force=>{
 if(!force&&Time.time-lastDiagnostic<1f)return;lastDiagnostic=Time.time;
 bool inMain=UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene().name=="Main";
 var enemies=inMain?UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsByType<EnemyController>(FindObjectsSortMode.None):new EnemyController[0];
 var live=enemies.Where(e=>e!=null&&e.HP>0f).ToArray();
 var rows=live.Length>0?live:new EnemyController[]{null};var output=new System.Text.StringBuilder();
 foreach(var e in rows){
  var cb=e!=null?e.GetComponent<Collider2D>():null;Bounds bounds=cb!=null?cb.bounds:default(Bounds);
  object ai=e!=null&&enemyAIField!=null?enemyAIField.GetValue(e):null;string aiState="",aiPhase="";
  if(ai!=null){var type=ai.GetType();var stateField=type.GetField("state",flags)??type.GetField("movementState",flags);var phaseField=type.GetField("phase",flags);var winding=type.GetField("windingUp",flags);var gateTimer=type.GetField("gateAttackTimer",flags);
   aiState=stateField!=null?stateField.GetValue(ai).ToString():winding!=null?"windingUp="+winding.GetValue(ai):gateTimer!=null?"gateAttackTimer="+number((float)gateTimer.GetValue(ai)):"native";
   aiPhase=phaseField!=null?phaseField.GetValue(ai).ToString():"";
  }
  var values=new[]{number(Time.time-started),(StageCounter.Instance!=null?StageCounter.Instance.StageCount:lastStage).ToString(),status!=null?number(status.HP):"",status!=null?number(status.GATE):"",player!=null?number(player.transform.position.x):"",player!=null?number(player.transform.position.y):"",body!=null?number(body.linearVelocity.x):"",body!=null?number(body.linearVelocity.y):"",(flow!=null&&flow.IsStageActive).ToString(),StageFlowManager.IsPlayerInputBlocked.ToString(),player!=null?number((float)coolTimeField.GetValue(player)):"",attackSuppression,attackEvents.ToString(),diagnosticTarget!=null?diagnosticTarget.GetInstanceID().ToString():"",e!=null?e.GetInstanceID().ToString():"",e!=null&&e.enemyData!=null?e.enemyData.enemyName:"",e!=null?number(e.HP):"",e!=null?number(e.transform.position.x):"",e!=null?number(e.transform.position.y):"",cb!=null?number(bounds.min.x):"",cb!=null?number(bounds.min.y):"",cb!=null?number(bounds.max.x):"",cb!=null?number(bounds.max.y):"",cb!=null&&player!=null?number(Vector2.Distance(player.transform.position,bounds.ClosestPoint(player.transform.position))):"",ai!=null?ai.GetType().Name:"",aiState,aiPhase,(e!=null&&e.enemyData!=null&&e.enemyData.IsBossType).ToString(),live.Length.ToString(),force.ToString()};
  output.Append(string.Join(",",values.Select(csv).ToArray())).Append('\n');
 }
 System.IO.File.AppendAllText(samplePath,output.ToString());
};
// Read-only per-game-frame observations. No transform/physics synchronization or bot changes.
string geometryPath=folder+label+"-geometry.csv",projectilePath=folder+label+"-projectiles-first-seen.csv";
var geometryBuffer=new System.Text.StringBuilder();
var projectileSeen=new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<int>();

System.Func<Bounds,float> geometryFloor=b=>{
 float top=float.NegativeInfinity;
 foreach(var c in geometryTerrain)if(c!=null&&c.enabled&&c.gameObject.activeInHierarchy){var t=c.bounds;if(t.min.x<=b.max.x&&t.max.x>=b.min.x)top=Mathf.Max(top,t.max.y);}
 return top;
};
System.Action geometryFlush=()=>{if(geometryBuffer.Length>0){System.IO.File.AppendAllText(geometryPath,geometryBuffer.ToString());geometryBuffer.Length=0;}geometryLastFlush=Time.time;};
System.Action<EnemyController[]> observeGeometry=enemies=>{
 if(player==null||playerCollider==null)return;
 var bosses=enemies.Where(e=>e!=null&&e.HP>0f&&e.enemyData!=null&&e.enemyData.IsBossType).ToArray();
 if(bosses.Length==0)return;
 Bounds p=playerCollider.bounds,g=geometryGateCollider!=null?geometryGateCollider.bounds:default(Bounds);
 float floor=geometryFloor(p);
 foreach(var e in bosses){
  var ec=e.GetComponent<Collider2D>();if(ec==null)continue;Bounds b=ec.bounds;float bf=geometryFloor(b);
  var values=new[]{number(Time.time-started),Time.frameCount.ToString(),(StageCounter.Instance!=null?StageCounter.Instance.StageCount:lastStage).ToString(),number(status.HP),number(status.GATE),attackEvents.ToString(),number(player.transform.position.x),number(player.transform.position.y),number(body.linearVelocity.x),number(body.linearVelocity.y),number(p.min.x),number(p.min.y),number(p.max.x),number(p.max.y),number(floor),number(floor-p.min.y),e.GetInstanceID().ToString(),e.enemyData.enemyName,number(e.HP),number(e.transform.position.x),number(e.transform.position.y),number(b.min.x),number(b.min.y),number(b.max.x),number(b.max.y),number(bf),number(bf-b.min.y),number(Mathf.Max(0f,Mathf.Min(p.max.x,b.max.x)-Mathf.Max(p.min.x,b.min.x))),number(Mathf.Max(0f,Mathf.Min(p.max.y,b.max.y)-Mathf.Max(p.min.y,b.min.y))),number(g.min.x),number(g.max.x),number(g.min.y),number(g.max.y),attackSuppression};
  geometryBuffer.AppendLine(string.Join(",",values.Select(csv).ToArray()));
 }
 var bb=bosses.FirstOrDefault(e=>e.enemyData.enemyName=="BB-413");
 if(bb!=null){
  var allowed=new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<string>((bb.enemyData.bulletPrefabs??new GameObject[0]).Where(go=>go!=null).Select(go=>go.name));
  Bounds b=bb.GetComponent<Collider2D>().bounds;
  foreach(var projectile in UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsByType<EnemyBulletController>(FindObjectsSortMode.None)){
   if(projectile==null||!projectile.gameObject.activeInHierarchy||!allowed.Contains(projectile.name.Replace("(Clone)",""))||!projectileSeen.Add(projectile.GetInstanceID()))continue;
   var c=projectile.GetComponent<Collider2D>();if(c==null)continue;var rb=projectile.GetComponent<Rigidbody2D>();Bounds q=c.bounds;Vector2 v=rb!=null?rb.linearVelocity:Vector2.zero;
   var values=new[]{number(Time.time-started),Time.frameCount.ToString(),(StageCounter.Instance!=null?StageCounter.Instance.StageCount:lastStage).ToString(),"first_editor_frame_not_instant_spawn",projectile.GetInstanceID().ToString(),projectile.name,number(projectile.bulletDamage),number(projectile.transform.position.x),number(projectile.transform.position.y),number(v.x),number(v.y),number(q.min.x),number(q.min.y),number(q.max.x),number(q.max.y),number(g.min.x),number(g.max.x),number(g.min.y),number(g.max.y),number(Mathf.Max(0f,Mathf.Min(q.max.x,g.max.x)-Mathf.Max(q.min.x,g.min.x))),number(Mathf.Max(0f,Mathf.Min(q.max.y,g.max.y)-Mathf.Max(q.min.y,g.min.y))),number(q.min.x-g.max.x),bb.GetInstanceID().ToString(),number(b.min.x),number(b.min.y),number(b.max.x),number(b.max.y)};
   System.IO.File.AppendAllText(projectilePath,string.Join(",",values.Select(csv).ToArray())+"\n");
  }
 }
 if(Time.time-geometryLastFlush>=1f)geometryFlush();
};

UnityEditor.EditorApplication.CallbackFunction tick=null;
System.Action<string> finish=reason=>{
 if(done)return;done=true;UnityEditor.EditorApplication.update-=tick;
 try{
  geometryFlush();
  attackSuppression="finished:"+reason+";previous="+attackSuppression;sampleDiagnostics(true);
  closeWave(reason);
  foreach(int id in bossStarts.Keys)if(closedBosses.Add(id))recordBoss(id,"ended",reason);
  record("finished",reason);
  if(status!=null)System.IO.File.WriteAllText(folder+label+"-final-status.json",JsonUtility.ToJson(status,true));
  if(MaterialManager.Instance!=null)System.IO.File.WriteAllText(folder+label+"-final-materials.json",JsonUtility.ToJson(MaterialManager.Instance,true));
  System.IO.File.WriteAllText(folder+label+"-result.txt","result="+reason+"\nstart_hp="+number(initialHP)+"\nstart_gate="+number(initialGate)+"\nend_hp="+(status!=null?number(status.HP):"unknown")+"\nend_gate="+(status!=null?number(status.GATE):"unknown")+"\nstart_stage="+firstStage+"\nlast_stage="+lastStage+"\ncompleted_native_waves="+completedWaves+"\nrewards_selected="+rewards+"\ngame_seconds="+(Time.time-started).ToString("F3",invariant)+"\nwall_seconds="+(UnityEditor.EditorApplication.timeSinceStartup-wallStarted).ToString("F3",invariant)+"\nshots="+shots+"\nattack_events="+attackEvents+"\nplayer_damage="+playerDamage.ToString("F2",invariant)+"\ngate_damage="+gateDamage.ToString("F2",invariant)+"\nplayer_healed="+playerHealed.ToString("F2",invariant)+"\ngate_healed="+gateHealed.ToString("F2",invariant)+"\n");
  System.IO.File.WriteAllText(folder+label+"-restore-pending.txt","Root must restore and verify the current session PlayerPrefs/editor backup after Play stops. Runner does not write PlayerPrefs.\n");
 }catch(System.Exception ex){System.IO.File.AppendAllText(folder+label+"-errors.txt",ex+"\n");}
 finally{
  if(player!=null){coolTimeField.SetValue(player,oldCoolTime);player.enabled=oldPlayerEnabled;}if(arm!=null)arm.enabled=oldArmEnabled;
  Time.captureDeltaTime=oldCapture;Time.timeScale=oldScale;QualitySettings.vSyncCount=oldVSync;Application.targetFrameRate=oldTarget;Application.runInBackground=oldBackground;
  System.IO.File.WriteAllText(progress,"COMPLETE "+label+" "+reason+"\n");
  // Root owns save restoration after teardown; no persistent cross-case callback is installed.
  Time.timeScale=0f; // Generated batch only: retain Play between cases.
 }
};
bRouteFinish=finish; // Generated cleanup hook; normal route semantics unchanged.
System.Func<BonusCardDataSO,float> cardScore=data=>{
 if(data==null||data.effects==null)return 0f;float score=0f;bool meleeTarget=mainWeapon.weaponType==WeaponType.Melee;
 foreach(var effect in data.effects){if(effect==null)continue;float value=effect.value;
  if(effect.type==CardEffectType.AddHP&&status.HP<=60&&value>0)score+=10000f+Mathf.Min(value,100-status.HP);
  else if(effect.type==CardEffectType.AddGateHP&&status.GATE<=Mathf.Min(100f,initialGate*.5f)&&value>0)score+=9000f+value;
  else if((meleeTarget&&effect.type==CardEffectType.AddSTR)||(!meleeTarget&&effect.type==CardEffectType.AddACC))score+=100f+value;
  else if(meleeTarget&&effect.type==CardEffectType.ConvertACCtoSTR&&status.ACC>=(int)value)score+=100f+value;
  else if(!meleeTarget&&effect.type==CardEffectType.ConvertSTRtoACC&&status.STR>=(int)value)score+=100f+value;
  else if(weaponName=="GearCraft"&&effect.type==CardEffectType.GearCraftAxeSizeMultiplier)score+=60f+10f*Mathf.Max(0f,value-1f);
  else if(weaponName=="SteamCannon"&&(effect.type==CardEffectType.SteamCannonGiantBulletChance||effect.type==CardEffectType.SteamCannonExplosionRadiusMultiplier||effect.type==CardEffectType.SteamCannonDirectHitKnockback))score+=60f+value;
  else if(weaponName=="SteamThrower"&&effect.type==CardEffectType.SteamThrowerOverheatSlipDamage)score+=60f+value;
  else if(weaponName=="RailCraft"&&(effect.type==CardEffectType.RailCraftBulletSizeMultiplier||effect.type==CardEffectType.RailCraftApplyOverheat))score+=60f+value;
  else if(weaponName=="SteamGatling"&&(effect.type==CardEffectType.SteamGatlingBossDamageMultiplier||effect.type==CardEffectType.SteamGatlingNormalDamageMultiplier))score+=10f*(value-1f);
 }
 return score;
};
player.enabled=false;arm.enabled=false;coolTimeField.SetValue(player,0f);

tick=()=>{bool processCooldown=false;try{

  return;
 }

 // Choose nearest threat to gate, but ignore enemies until their body enters the visible area.

 if(weaponName=="GearCraft"){
   // Match normal 5s axe / 5s sword transform cadence; no permanent axe equip.
   var desired=((Time.time-started)%10f<5f)?sword:axe;if(status.currentWeapon!=desired){status.EquipWeapon(desired);player.currentWeapon=desired;sync.Invoke(player,null);updateAnim.Invoke(player,null);}
 }
 var weapon=status.currentWeapon;

 arm.arm.localScale=scale;
 if(melee)arm.arm.position=player.transform.position+offset;
 if(target==null&&intercept==null){attackSuppression="no_visible_target";body.linearVelocity=new Vector2(applyReactiveDash(0f),body.linearVelocity.y);return;}

 float desiredDistance=melee?1.1f:weaponName=="SteamThrower"?3.2f:weaponName=="SteamGatling"?5f:7f;

 // Use native shoulder pose/muzzle offsets; aim at closest visible body point, with gravity correction.

 aim.y-=.5f*Physics2D.gravity.y*gravity*travel*travel;

  float spread=weapon.spreadAngle+status.spreadModifier;
  float finalAngle=(float)calculateSpread.Invoke(null,new object[]{angle,spread});

  Vector3 muzzle=(Vector3)getMuzzle.Invoke(player,new object[]{dir});
  damageField.SetValue(player,weapon.baseDamage);
  if(weapon.useLineHitbox){lineAttack.Invoke(player,new object[]{dir,finalAngle,muzzle});shots++;}
  else{
   var bullet=UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(weapon.bulletPrefab,muzzle,Quaternion.Euler(0f,0f,finalAngle));
   if(bullet==null)throw new System.Exception("Primary projectile Instantiate returned null");
   var rb=bullet.GetComponent<Rigidbody2D>();if(rb!=null)rb.linearVelocity=dir*(float)getBulletSpeed.Invoke(player,null);
   configure.Invoke(player,new object[]{bullet});shots++;
   if(status.hasBulletDouble){
    float secondAngle=(float)calculateSpread.Invoke(null,new object[]{angle,spread});
    Vector2 secondDirection=new Vector2(Mathf.Cos(secondAngle*Mathf.Deg2Rad),Mathf.Sin(secondAngle*Mathf.Deg2Rad));
    Vector3 secondMuzzle=(Vector3)getMuzzle.Invoke(player,new object[]{secondDirection});
    var secondBullet=UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(weapon.bulletPrefab,secondMuzzle,Quaternion.Euler(0f,0f,secondAngle));
    if(secondBullet==null)throw new System.Exception("Secondary projectile Instantiate returned null");
    var secondBody=secondBullet.GetComponent<Rigidbody2D>();if(secondBody!=null)secondBody.linearVelocity=secondDirection*(float)getBulletSpeed.Invoke(player,null);
    configure.Invoke(player,new object[]{secondBullet});shots++;
   }
   gatlingRecoil.Invoke(player,new object[]{dir});
  }
  attackEvents++;
 }finally{aimRandom=UnityEngine.Random.state;UnityEngine.Random.state=savedRandom;}
 // BOT_SHARED_BLOCK_END
 }catch(System.Exception ex){System.IO.File.AppendAllText(folder+label+"-errors.txt",ex+"\n");finish("failed_"+ex.Message);}

  // Record once per second after the actual decision; observation never changes bot behavior.
  if(processCooldown&&!done&&Application.isPlaying)sampleDiagnostics(false);
  // Also advances while native UI blocks attacks; no decrement after restoration.
  if(processCooldown&&!done&&Application.isPlaying&&player!=null&&!player.enabled&&UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene().name=="Main")coolTimeUpdate.Invoke(player,null);
 }
};

  if(bBootstrapCleanup!=null)bBootstrapCleanup();bBootstrapCleanup=null;

  System.IO.File.WriteAllText(bFolder+"batch-restore-pending.txt","Root must restore and verify this session's original PlayerPrefs/editor/GameView/logger backups after Play stops. Batch restores only its entry runtime settings.\n");
 }finally{
  Time.timeScale=bOldScale;Time.captureDeltaTime=bOldCapture;QualitySettings.vSyncCount=bOldVsync;Application.targetFrameRate=bOldTarget;Application.runInBackground=bOldBackground;Debug.unityLogger.filterLogType=bOldFilter;Debug.unityLogger.logEnabled=bOldLogEnabled;
  if(Application.isPlaying)UnityEditor.EditorApplication.isPlaying=false;
 }

System.Action bLoadTitle=()=>{
 // Drain destroyed Player death/BOOST continuations while no Main managers exist.
 // Do not set the next build until their shared StatusManager writes have finished.
 Time.timeScale=1f;Time.captureDeltaTime=1f/60f;bState=1;bTitleFrame=-1;bTitleSceneHandle=-1;bTitleStartedGame=-1f;bPhaseAt=UnityEditor.EditorApplication.timeSinceStartup;

};
bTick=()=>{
 if(bDone)return;
 try{
  double bNow=UnityEditor.EditorApplication.timeSinceStartup;
  if(!Application.isPlaying){bStop("Play stopped externally",true);return;}
  if(System.IO.File.Exists(bFolder+"cancel-defense-batch.txt")||System.IO.File.Exists(bFolder+"cancel-native-survival.txt")){bStop("cancelled_by_sentinel",true);return;}
  if(bNow-bStartedAt>60+bPending.Count*380){bStop("batch_wall_timeout",true);return;}
  if(bState!=3&&bState!=0&&bNow-bPhaseAt>45){bStop("initialization_timeout_state_"+bState,true);return;}
  if(bNow-bLastProgress>=2){bLastProgress=bNow;System.IO.File.WriteAllText(bFolder+"batch-progress.txt","RUNNING "+bSession+" case="+bCurrentLabel+" completed="+bCompleted+"/"+bPending.Count+" state="+bState+" wall="+(bNow-bStartedAt).ToString("F1",System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)+"\n");}
  if(bState==0){
   if(bIndex>=bPending.Count){bStop("all_cases_finished",false);return;}
   bCurrent=bPending[bIndex];bCurrentLabel=bCurrent["label"];
   if(System.IO.Directory.GetFiles(bFolder,bCurrentLabel+"-*").Length>0)throw new System.Exception("Case appeared after preflight; refusing overwrite: "+bCurrentLabel);
   bExpectedConfig=bCurrent["weapon"]+","+bCurrent["start_stage"]+","+bCurrent["profile"]+","+bCurrent["seed"];
   System.IO.File.WriteAllText(bFolder+"native-survival-config.csv",bExpectedConfig+"\n");
   System.IO.File.WriteAllText(bFolder+"native-survival-name.txt",bCurrentLabel+"\n");
   System.IO.File.WriteAllText(bFolder+"bot-mode.txt","reactive\n");System.IO.File.WriteAllText(bFolder+"allow-boost.txt","true\n");
   bRecord("case_begin",bExpectedConfig);
   if(bReuseInitialMain){bReuseInitialMain=false;bState=2;bPhaseAt=bNow;bRecord("reuse_initial_ready","Paused Main/bootstrap matches first pending case");}
   else bLoadTitle();
   return;
  }
  if(bState==1){
   if(UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene().name!="Title")return;
   if(StatusManager.Instance==null||MaterialManager.Instance==null)return;
   int bSceneHandle=UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene().handle;
   if(bTitleFrame<0||bTitleSceneHandle!=bSceneHandle){bTitleFrame=Time.frameCount;bTitleSceneHandle=bSceneHandle;bTitleStartedGame=Time.time;return;}
   Time.timeScale=1f;Time.captureDeltaTime=1f/60f;
   if(Time.frameCount-bTitleFrame<360||Time.time-bTitleStartedGame<6f)return;
   if(StageFlowManager.Instance!=null)throw new System.Exception("Old Main flow survived into stable Title");
   if(UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsByType<SceneTransitionManager>(FindObjectsSortMode.None).Any(bTransition=>bTransition!=null&&bTransition.IsLoading))return;
   var bResetEnding=typeof(EndingManager).GetMethod("ResetRuntimeState",System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Static|System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic);
   if(bResetEnding==null)throw new System.Exception("Ending runtime reset method missing");bResetEnding.Invoke(null,null);
   if(EndingManager.IsLoadingEnding||EndingManager.PendingEndingNum!=0)throw new System.Exception("Ending state did not reset");
   bRecord("title_stable","6 game seconds and at least 360 frames elapsed at captureDeltaTime=1/60; no Main flow or active scene transition; native Ending runtime reset complete");
   bState=2;bPhaseAt=bNow;bRecord("bootstrap_invoked",bRunBootstrap());return;
  }
  if(bState==2){
   string bBoot=System.IO.File.Exists(bFolder+"native-survival-bootstrap-progress.txt")?System.IO.File.ReadAllText(bFolder+"native-survival-bootstrap-progress.txt"):"";
   if(bBoot.StartsWith("FAILED"))throw new System.Exception("Bootstrap failed: "+bBoot);
   if(!bBoot.StartsWith("READY "+bExpectedConfig+" "))return;
   if(UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene().name!="Main")throw new System.Exception("READY outside Main");
   if(bBootstrapCleanup!=null)bBootstrapCleanup();bBootstrapCleanup=null;
   var bRuntimeStatus=StatusManager.Instance;var bRuntimePlayer=UnityEngine.Object.FindFirstObjectByType<PlayerController>();var bRuntimeFlow=StageFlowManager.Instance;
   if(bRuntimeStatus==null||bRuntimePlayer==null||bRuntimeFlow==null)throw new System.Exception("READY managers missing");
   if(bRuntimeStatus.craftWeaponDamagebuff!=int.Parse(bCurrent["moduleDamage"]))throw new System.Exception("Loadout module damage differs from case plan");
   bRuntimeStatus.STR=int.Parse(bCurrent["STR"]);bRuntimeStatus.ACC=int.Parse(bCurrent["ACC"]);
   bRuntimeStatus.HP=int.Parse(bCurrent["initial_hp"]);bRuntimeStatus.GATE=float.Parse(bCurrent["initial_gate"],System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
   bRuntimeStatus.module_repair=bCurrent["repair"]=="1";bRuntimeStatus.module_barrier=bCurrent["barrier"]=="1";bRuntimeStatus.module_scrap=bCurrent["scrap_module"]=="1";bRuntimeStatus.punkDrive=bCurrent["punk"]=="1";
   bRuntimePlayer.STR=bRuntimeStatus.STR;bRuntimePlayer.ACC=bRuntimeStatus.ACC;
   if(bRuntimePlayer.punkdrive!=null)bRuntimePlayer.punkdrive.SetActive(bRuntimeStatus.punkDrive);
   var bSnapshot=typeof(StageFlowManager).GetMethod("CaptureDayStartSnapshot",System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance|System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic);
   if(bSnapshot==null)throw new System.Exception("Native day snapshot method missing");bSnapshot.Invoke(bRuntimeFlow,null);
   if(System.IO.Directory.GetFiles(bFolder,bCurrentLabel+"-*").Length>0)throw new System.Exception("Case artifacts appeared before route; refusing overwrite");
   bState=3;bPhaseAt=bNow;bRecord("route_invoked",bRunRoute());return;
  }
  if(bState==3){
   if(bNow-bPhaseAt>340){bStop("route_wall_watchdog",true);return;}
   string bRouteProgress=System.IO.File.Exists(bFolder+"native-survival-progress.txt")?System.IO.File.ReadAllText(bFolder+"native-survival-progress.txt"):"";
   if(!bRouteProgress.StartsWith("COMPLETE "+bCurrentLabel+" "))return;
   bRouteFinish=null; // Native finish already removed its own update callback.
   string bCompletedPath=bFolder+bCurrentLabel+"-result.txt";
   if(!System.IO.File.Exists(bCompletedPath))throw new System.Exception("COMPLETE without result file");
   var bResult=bReadResult(bCompletedPath);
   if(!bResult.ContainsKey("result")||!bResult.ContainsKey("game_seconds")||!bResult.ContainsKey("last_stage"))throw new System.Exception("Incomplete native result");
   string bReason=bResult["result"];
   if(System.IO.File.Exists(bFolder+bCurrentLabel+"-errors.txt")&&!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(System.IO.File.ReadAllText(bFolder+bCurrentLabel+"-errors.txt")))throw new System.Exception("Native errors file: "+bCurrentLabel);
   bool bExpectedTerminal=bReason=="player_dead"||bReason=="gate_destroyed"||bReason=="game_timeout_900s"||bReason.StartsWith("native_day_cleared")||bReason.StartsWith("ending_reached_");
   if(!bExpectedTerminal)throw new System.Exception("Unexpected native termination: "+bReason);
   bRecord("case_complete",bReason+" game_seconds="+bResult["game_seconds"]);bCompleted++;bIndex++;bState=0;bPhaseAt=bNow;Time.timeScale=0f;
  }
 }catch(System.Exception bException){
  System.IO.File.AppendAllText(bFolder+"batch-errors-"+bSession+".txt",bException+"\n");bStop(bException.Message,true);
 }
};
System.IO.File.WriteAllText(bFolder+"batch-progress.txt","RUNNING "+bSession+" pending="+bPending.Count+" skipped="+bSkipped.Count+"\n");
foreach(string bSkippedLabel in bSkipped)bRecord("skip_existing_complete",bSkippedLabel);
UnityEditor.EditorApplication.update+=bTick;
return "Scheduled continuous-Play gate defense batch: "+bPending.Count+" pending; "+bSkipped.Count+" existing results skipped; inspect "+bFolder+"batch-progress.txt; root restores original session backups after completion";

} }
